bio: I am a certified STEM educator with over 10 years of teaching experience in secondary and higher education. My background spans Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, and Mathematics. I hold a Master of Science in Engineering and a Master of Science in Teaching major in Mathematics, and I am currently pursuing a doctorate in Educational Management.

My interests include mathematical investigation and modeling, embedded systems, robotics, IoT, automation, programming, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. I bring these into the classroom through research and hands on projects that strengthen students’ analytical, problem solving, and technical skills. I also mentor student researchers, guiding them through prototype development, system testing, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Through formative assessment, data informed instruction, and targeted academic support, I have helped improve student performance by 20 to 25%, with approximately 90% mastery of targeted learning competencies.
